description: Personal media tracking desktop app — Electron + TypeScript + SQLite. Tracks shows, anime, movies, books, and manga.

preferences: Frequent inline comments explaining TypeScript/web syntax via Java or C++ analogies
Responses should be reasonably concise but thorough when explaining new concepts
Never introduce horizontal scrollbars anywhere in the UI
Keyboard-first: every feature should be reachable without a mouse (see keyboard_navigation)

tech_stack.database: SQLite via better-sqlite3 (native module — requires asarUnpack)
tech_stack.ci: GitHub Actions (release.yml) — triggers on v* tags, builds on windows-latest, uploads .exe to GitHub Release

project_structure.src/main/main.ts: Electron main process, IPC handlers, DB + config init. Config stored at userData/config.json for API keys. Also holds the AniList GraphQL query, request queue (anilistFetch) and result mapping.
project_structure.src/main/database.ts: MediaDatabase class — all SQLite logic, CRUD for media/tags/fields/rating
project_structure.src/main/preload.ts: contextBridge security bridge — exposes window.api to renderer
project_structure.src/renderer/renderer.ts: All UI logic — state, card rendering, modals (add/edit/detail/settings/help), AniList/TMDB search, genre picker + genre filter, filters, auto-refresh, and the whole keyboard layer (Keyboard Navigation section: key bindings, handleKeydown and its helpers)
project_structure.src/renderer/globals.d.ts: TypeScript declaration for window.api (top-level interface Window, NOT export {} — would crash renderer)
project_structure.public/index.html: App shell HTML — sidebar, header filters (type chips, genre panel with filter box, sort), media grid, add/edit modal, detail modal, settings modal (API key + key binding editor), shortcut help overlay. Content-Security-Policy meta tag lives here (img-src must list every cover-image host).
project_structure.public/styles.css: Dark theme CSS with custom properties. Keyboard-navigation styles (focus rings, delete-confirm, help dialog, key binding editor) are appended at the end.
project_structure.ARCHITECTURE.md: Explains the two-process model, IPC, schema, auto-fill APIs and keyboard layer
project_structure.TODO.md: Personal task list and setup steps

database_schema.media: id, title, type, status, rating INTEGER, date_added, notes
database_schema.media_tags: media_id FK→media.id CASCADE, tag_id FK→tags.id CASCADE — many-to-many join
database_schema.media_fields: id, media_id FK→media.id CASCADE, field_name, field_value — flexible key-value store for all per-entry extras

media_fields_keys.image_url: Cover poster URL (from AniList coverImage.large or TMDB w500). Used on cards and detail view.
media_fields_keys.description: Plot synopsis auto-filled from AniList/TMDB. NOT editable in modal — set only via auto-fill or startup refresh.
media_fields_keys.title_english: English title for anime/manga where main title is Japanese. Searched alongside media.title in searchMedia query.
media_fields_keys.episodes: Total episode count (anime/show). Displayed as part of episode progress.
media_fields_keys.current_episode: Episode the user is currently on. Only saved when status = 'in_progress'. Shown as 'Ep X / Y'.
media_fields_keys.year: Release year. Auto-filled from AniList/TMDB. NOT editable in modal — set only via auto-fill or startup refresh. Shown on cards and detail view.

ipc_api.note: All methods on window.api in preload.ts map 1:1 to ipcMain.handle() names in main.ts
methods: addMedia(title, type, status, rating, notes) → MediaEntry
searchMedia(query) → MediaEntry[]  — searches both title and media_fields title_english via LEFT JOIN
updateMedia(id, title, type, status, rating, notes) → void
updateRating(id, rating) → void  — lightweight rating-only update, used by card star clicks

searchAnilist(mediaType, query) → any[]  — IPC channel 'search-anilist'. AniList GraphQL API, anime or manga, no key needed. Returns Jikan-shaped objects (title, title_english, synopsis, year, episodes, volumes, genres[{name}], images.jpg.{image_url,large_image_url}). Replaced Jikan, whose public API was shut down in Oct 2026. Returns [] on any failure (logged in the terminal).
searchTmdb(mediaType, query) → { results?, error? }  — TMDB search, requires stored API key
getTmdbTvDetails(showId) → any  — fetches /tv/{id} for episode count (not in search results)
getApiKey(keyName) → string | null  — reads from userData/config.json
setApiKey(keyName, value) → void   — writes to userData/config.json

renderer_state.currentTab: string — 'all' | 'search' | 'mylist' (genres are no longer a tab; see genreFilterSet)
renderer_state.genreFilterSet: Set<string> — genres selected in the header genre filter
renderer_state.genreFilterMode: 'and' | 'or' — whether an entry must have all selected genres or any
renderer_state.currentSort: 'az' | 'za' | 'rating-high' | 'rating-low' — default 'az'; the sort button cycles through them
renderer_state.allGenres: string[] — full genre name list from DB, kept in sync when modal opens
renderer_state.selectedGenres: Set<string> — genres selected in the currently open modal
renderer_state.editingEntryId: number | null — null = add mode, number = edit mode for that entry's id
renderer_state.currentRating: number | null — star rating (1-5) selected in the open modal
renderer_state.currentImageUrl: string | null — cover URL from auto-fill, saved to media_fields on save
renderer_state.currentTitleEnglish: string | null — English title from AniList, saved to media_fields as title_english
renderer_state.currentYear: string | null — release year from auto-fill, saved to media_fields as year. No UI input — auto-fill only.
renderer_state.currentDescription: string | null — synopsis from auto-fill, saved to media_fields as description. No UI input — auto-fill only.
renderer_state.keyBinds: Record<actionId, key> — current key bindings (defaults + localStorage overrides)
renderer_state.capturingActionId: string | null — set while Settings waits for the next key press to rebind an action
renderer_state.cardHandlers: WeakMap<card element, {open, edit, remove, rate}> — what the keyboard can do to each card
renderer_state.returnFocusEl / genreFilterReturnEl: Element to refocus when a dialog / the genre filter closes
renderer_state.pendingDeleteCard: Card awaiting the second Delete press (3s timeout)
renderer_state.genreActions / genreHighlight: Rows and highlighted row of the Add/Edit dialog's genre dropdown

statuses.planning: Displayed as 'Plan to Watch' — stored value is still 'planning' to preserve existing data

modal_field_order: Type (select) — must be first so AniList/TMDB section visibility is set immediately
Title (override — auto-filled by AniList/TMDB but editable)
Extra fields: Episodes (Current / Total, shown for anime/show) | Pages (book) | Volumes (manga)
Note: Current Episode only shown when status = in_progress
Genres (searchable multi-select; dropdown opens on Enter or mouse click, never on focus)
NOTE: Year and Description are intentionally absent from the modal — they are auto-fill/refresh only
Keyboard: Up/Down ONLY move between these fields; Left/Right step through lists (drop-down value, stars, auto-fill results, genre dropdown, Cancel/Save); drop-downs open on Enter

card_layout.cover_image: Top of card, edge-to-edge, 200px tall. Inserted via DOM (not innerHTML) to set img.src safely.
card_layout.title: Clamped to 2 lines with text-overflow ellipsis
card_layout.status_row: Single flex row: [status badge] [year if present] [episode info] [5 star rating].
card_layout.card_actions: Edit (✎) and Delete (✕) buttons, always visible at top-right with semi-transparent background. Mouse delete has NO confirmation yet; keyboard delete needs two presses.
card_layout.keyboard: Cards are tabindex=-1 (roving tabindex: the focused card is the Tab stop); inner buttons are tabindex=-1 so Tab skips them. Focused card gets an accent outline via :focus-visible.

startup_refresh.trigger: DOMContentLoaded — fired with 'void refreshAllEntries()' (non-blocking) after initial loadMedia/loadGenres
startup_refresh.scope: All entries except books (AniList/TMDB have no book support)
startup_refresh.order: Most recently added first (follows getAllMedia() ORDER BY date_added DESC)
startup_refresh.delays: AniList limit is 30 req/min (X-RateLimit-Limit header): main process queues requests ~2.2s apart and retries 429s using Retry-After (see anilistFetch in main.ts), so a big library refreshes slowly in the background (~2s per anime/manga entry); 350ms between TMDB requests (movie/show)
startup_refresh.anilist_fallback: Tries title_english first, then item.title as a second query if the first returns empty
startup_refresh.fields_preserved: current_episode and any other non-AUTO_FILL_KEYS fields are carried over unchanged
startup_refresh.genres: New genres from API are added; existing genres are never removed (preserves manually added ones)
startup_refresh.completion: Shows 'Metadata refresh complete.' toast when all entries are processed
startup_refresh.toast: Toast stays visible until user dismisses it with the × button — no auto-dismiss

keyboard_navigation.where: renderer.ts 'Keyboard Navigation' section — one document keydown listener (handleKeydown) routes every key
keyboard_navigation.routing_order: binding capture → Ctrl+S (help) → Ctrl+Enter (save dialog) → other Ctrl/Alt combos ignored → Esc → open dialog (Tab trap / detail keys / add-edit keys) → text boxes → genre filter → bound shortcuts → grid keys
keyboard_navigation.bindings: KEY_ACTIONS table = rebindable actions (id, label, group, defaultKey). Saved in localStorage 'media-library.keybinds' (per machine, not config.json). Edited in Settings (click a key, press the new one; saves instantly). The help dialog is generated from current bindings.
keyboard_navigation.default_keys: / search, n new entry, a All tab, l My List tab, [ ] type filter, , . status filter, s sort, g genre filter, o settings, ? help, Enter open, e edit, Delete delete (press twice), m / c = genre-list match mode / clear
keyboard_navigation.rules: Single keys only (no Ctrl/Alt combos). Fixed, not rebindable: Esc, Tab, Space, Backspace, arrows, Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, 0-5 (rating), Ctrl+Enter (save dialog), Ctrl+S (toggle help; works while typing). Binding a key already in use is rejected, not swapped.
keyboard_navigation.grid: Arrows move between cards (column count from offsetTop), Home/End, PgUp/PgDn = 3 rows. Enter/Space open details, E edit, 0-5 rate, Delete x2 delete. Focus returns to the same grid position after a re-render (renderMediaGrid).
keyboard_navigation.detail_view: Up/Down/PgUp/PgDn/Home/End scroll #detail-content manually (focus stays on the card behind the panel, so without this the grid behind would scroll); Left/Right flip to the previous/next entry; edit key edits.
keyboard_navigation.genre_filter: G opens the header genre panel with a type-to-filter box (#genre-filter-search). Box: Enter toggles first match, Down browses chips. Chips: arrows (row-aware via chipInAdjacentRow), Enter/Space toggle, m/c bound keys, typing jumps back to the box. Esc closes the panel and returns focus to the card you came from.
keyboard_navigation.add_edit_dialog: Up/Down ONLY move between fields (modalFieldStops, includes selects/notes/number boxes). Left/Right step through lists: stars (rating), selects (native), auto-fill results (Right at end of the box enters them), genre dropdown highlight, Cancel/Save. Selects open on Enter (showPicker) and Space is blocked. Genre dropdown opens on Enter or mouse click only; Backspace on an empty box removes the last chip; Esc closes just the dropdown. Ctrl+Enter saves.
keyboard_navigation.focus_management: rememberFocus()/restoreFocus() return focus to the card after any dialog closes; trapTab() keeps Tab inside open dialogs.

key_design_decisions: globals.d.ts uses top-level 'interface Window' (NOT export {}) — export {} compiles to Object.defineProperty(exports,...) which crashes in sandboxed renderer browser context
Genres field uses <div class='field-group'> NOT <label> — clicking a <label> activates the first focusable child, which would trigger chip-remove buttons unexpectedly
openGenrePicker() and initExtraFields() use data-wired flag to prevent re-attaching event listeners each time the modal opens
Genre dropdown items use mousedown instead of click so they fire BEFORE the input's blur event hides the dropdown
better-sqlite3 listed in asarUnpack so the native .node binary is not packed into the ASAR archive
Database stored at app.getPath('userData') — survives app reinstall, isolated per OS user
electron-builder uses --publish never flag; GitHub Release asset upload handled by softprops/action-gh-release@v2 action
Card stars are generated inside the innerHTML template (not inserted via DOM after the fact) — insertAdjacentElement was silently failing for some entries
AniList/TMDB API calls run in the main process (not renderer) to keep the renderer sandboxed and avoid CSP connect-src issues
TMDB TV episode count requires a separate /tv/{id} detail call — the search endpoint only returns genre_ids, not episode count
updateRating() is a separate lightweight IPC call so card star clicks update the DB without reloading the entire grid
current_episode is only saved when status = in_progress, and the input is hidden+cleared when status changes away from in_progress
Never add horizontal scrollbars anywhere in the UI — use min-width:0 on flex children, overflow-x:hidden on containers
year and description have no modal input fields — they are state variables (currentYear, currentDescription) set by auto-fill and saved on entry save
Toast notifications do not auto-dismiss — each toast has a × button the user must click to remove it

Content-Security-Policy img-src in index.html must list every cover host (*.anilist.co, cdn.myanimelist.net for old saved covers, image.tmdb.org). A missing host = valid URL saved but image silently blocked.
AniList is rate limited to 30 req/min; all requests go through one queue in main.ts (anilistFetch) with Retry-After handling. Do not call fetch to AniList directly.
searchAnilist returns Jikan-shaped objects on purpose so the renderer's fill/refresh code needed no changes after the Jikan shutdown
Key bindings live in localStorage (renderer-side), not config.json, because only the renderer uses them
Esc handling is centralized in handleEscape(); don't add separate Escape listeners
Detail-view scrolling is done in JS because focus stays on the card behind the overlay

Genre dropdown rows are driven by genreActions[] so mouse (mousedown) and keyboard (Enter) share the same code; the old Enter handler called .click() on rows that only listened for mousedown and did nothing

anilist.url: POST https://graphql.anilist.co (GraphQL; query in src/main/main.ts, results mapped to the old Jikan-like shape the renderer reads)

tmdb.key_storage: userData/config.json as 'tmdb_api_key', managed via Settings modal

build_and_release.local_build: npm run dist  (requires Admin or Developer Mode for symlink creation on Windows)
release_process: GitHub Actions builds on windows-latest and uploads both .exe files to the GitHub Release
outputs: release/Media Library Setup 0.1.0.exe — NSIS installer (recommended for end users)
release/Media Library 0.1.0.exe — Portable executable (no install needed)

known_issues_and_fixes: better-sqlite3 must be rebuilt for the target Electron version: npm run rebuild-sqlite
After Node.js install, must restart VSCode/terminal for PATH to update
Local dist build may fail with symlink error — run as Administrator or enable Windows Developer Mode
GitHub auth: configured for Daface314; if wrong account appears, clear Windows Credential Manager
HTTP 429 from AniList in the terminal = rate limit; the queue in main.ts retries automatically (look for 'AniList rate limit hit; retrying' warnings)
Covers missing for AniList entries = check the CSP img-src in public/index.html
package.json version is still 0.1.0 although tags v1.0.1 and v1.0.2 exist — bump it before the next release so installer filenames match the tag
